patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast imagery and solid color blocks serve as distinct, full-width section backgrounds, often with large text overlays.
Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display typography is used for primary section titles, creating strong visual anchors.
A stark palette of black, white, and a vibrant, almost neon orange is used for high contrast and to highlight key elements and imagery accents.
As the user scrolls, new content sections slide up into view from the bottom, replacing the previous section with a smooth transition.
Key sections are introduced by a single, massive word or short phrase, often overlapping a dramatic background image or solid color.

technique_notes: Sections are designed as full-viewport height blocks that reveal sequentially, sliding up into the viewport as the user scrolls down, creating a narrative flow. This is likely achieved using CSS keyframes triggered by scroll events.
Gritty, desaturated photographic or illustrative imagery with selective, vibrant orange highlights is used as full-bleed backgrounds to establish a strong, almost dystopian mood.
Large, bold, uppercase display text is positioned prominently, sometimes overlapping background elements, to act as powerful visual headings and brand statements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~5-10x body text) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.

standout: The site's aggressive, high-contrast visual style, combining gritty, desaturated imagery with vibrant orange accents and extremely large, bold, uppercase typography, creates a distinctive, almost brutalist or dystopian brand identity. The sequential, full-viewport section reveals contribute to a strong, immersive narrative experience.
